advancements.go_to_stardew_valley_food_w: Go To Stardew Valley Food World
info.sdvf.intext: So, this might be the last mod version before officially reaching version 0.3.0. After facing lengthy development challenges over the past four months, such as issues with creating recipes using Farmer's Delight and compatibility problems, this version of the mod will shift focus from cooking food to purchasing food from Villagers. Villagers will sell two random food items each time they take on a profession from the furnace.
